title: "parameter scaling"
output: html_document
date: "2026-08-26"
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```


```{r}
x <- 10
n <- 50

deg = 10

nnode_list <- x * 2^(0:(n - 1))
rho_list <- deg / nnode_list
er_list <- log(nnode_list) / nnode_list

# mean(rho_list > er_list)
```

```{r}
df <- data.frame(rho=rho_list, er=er_list, nnode=nnode_list) %>%
  mutate(pass = rho_list > er_list,
         conn = (nnode^2)*rho) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(rho, er), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value")

ggplot(df, aes(x=log2(nnode), y=log2(value), color=metric, shape=pass)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  theme_minimal()
```
